fullPassage:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution.

Sincerely,
Sarah Roberts

det.korean: 매표소를 다시 여는 것 / 역 직원을 교체하는 것 / 기차역을 폐쇄하는 것 / 새 발매기를 사는 것
det.analysis:
① reopening the ticket offices ←정답: 직원이 있는 매표소를 다시 열어 달라는 편지의 핵심 요청
② replacing the station staff: 직원 교체가 아니라 직원의 복귀를 원함
③ closing the train station: 역을 폐쇄하자는 내용은 글의 취지와 정반대
④ buying new vending machines: 발매기 구매는 글쓴이가 반대하는 방향임
det.tip: 글쓴이가 상대방에게 고려해 달라고 촉구하는 구체적 행동을 파악하세요.

questions.passage:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would __________. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution.

Sincerely,
Sarah Roberts
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 철도표를 잃다 / 철도 서비스 이용을 되찾다 / 발매기를 교체하다 / 역 직원을 피하다
det.analysis:
① lose their railway tickets: 표를 잃는다는 내용은 본문에 없음
② regain access to the railway services ←정답: 직원이 제자리로 돌아오면 많은 사람들이 철도 서비스 이용을 되찾는다는 원문 맥락
③ replace the vending machines: 발매기 교체는 언급되지 않음
④ avoid the station staff: 직원을 피하는 것이 아니라 직원의 도움을 원함
det.tip: 직원이 복귀했을 때 많은 사람들에게 일어나는 결과를 파악하세요.
